description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be discontinued.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 数据迁移实例id，可以通过调用 DescribeMigrationJobs 接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the data migration instance. You can call the DescribeMigrationJobs operation to query the ID.

description.zh: 数据迁移实例所在地域的id，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the data migration instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

title.zh: 查询迁移任务的监控报警
title.en: Query monitoring and alerts of a data migration task

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-migration-job-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --migration-job-id dtslb9113qq11n0000 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribeMigrationJobAlert --region cn-hangzhou --AccountId 123233440000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --MigrationJobId dtslb9113qq11n0000
